module Fastlane
  module Actions
    module SharedValues
      DSYM_PATHS = :DSYM_PATHS
      DSYM_LATEST_UPLOADED_DATE = :DSYM_LATEST_UPLOADED_DATE
    end
    class DownloadDsymsAction < Action
      # rubocop:disable Metrics/PerceivedComplexity
      def self.run(params)
        require 'openssl'
        require 'spaceship'
        require 'net/http'
        require 'date'

        reset_app_catalog_state
        @app_catalog_state[:action] = :download_dsyms

        # Team selection passed though FASTLANE_ITC_TEAM_ID and FASTLANE_ITC_TEAM_NAME environment variables
        # Prompts select team if multiple teams and none specified
        authorize_connect_client(params)

        # Get App
        app = Spaceship::ConnectAPI::App.find(params[:app_identifier])
        unless app
          UI.user_error!("Could not find app with bundle identifier '#{params[:app_identifier]}' on account #{params[:username]}")
        end

        # Process options
        version = params[:version]
        build_number = params[:build_number].to_s unless params[:build_number].nil?
        itc_platform = params[:platform]
        output_directory = params[:output_directory]
        wait_for_dsym_processing = params[:wait_for_dsym_processing]
        wait_timeout = params[:wait_timeout]
        min_version = parse_min_version(params[:min_version])
        after_uploaded_date = parse_after_uploaded_date(params[:after_uploaded_date])

        platform = Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Platform.map(itc_platform)

        # Set version if it is latest
        version, build_number = resolve_requested_version(version, build_number, app, platform)

        # Make sure output_directory has a slash on the end
        output_directory = normalize_output_directory(output_directory)

        record_build_selection(version, build_number, platform, min_version, after_uploaded_date)
        describe_dsym_lookup(params[:app_identifier], platform, version, build_number)

        filter = { app: app.id }
        filter["preReleaseVersion.platform"] = platform
        filter["preReleaseVersion.version"] = version if version
        filter["version"] = build_number if build_number
        build_resp = Spaceship::ConnectAPI.get_builds(filter: filter, sort: "-uploadedDate", includes: "preReleaseVersion,buildBundles")

        build_resp.all_pages_each do |build|
          asc_app_version = build.app_version
          asc_build_number = build.version
          uploaded_date = DateTime.parse(build.uploaded_date)

          message = []
          message << "Found train (version): #{asc_app_version}"
          message << ", comparing to supplied version: #{version}" if version
          UI.verbose(message.join(" "))

          if version && version != asc_app_version
            UI.verbose("Version #{version} doesn't match: #{asc_app_version}")
            next
          end

          if min_version && min_version > Gem::Version.new(asc_app_version)
            UI.verbose("Min version #{min_version} not reached: #{asc_app_version}")
            next
          end

          if after_uploaded_date && after_uploaded_date >= uploaded_date
            UI.verbose("Upload date #{after_uploaded_date} not reached: #{uploaded_date}")
            next
          end

          message = []
          message << "Found build version: #{asc_build_number}"
          message << ", comparing to supplied build_number: #{build_number}" if build_number
          UI.verbose(message.join(" "))

          if build_number && asc_build_number != build_number
            UI.verbose("build_version: #{asc_build_number} doesn't match: #{build_number}")
            next
          end

          UI.verbose("Build_version: #{asc_build_number} matches #{build_number}, grabbing dsym_url") if build_number
          download_dsym(build: build, app: app, wait_for_dsym_processing: wait_for_dsym_processing, wait_timeout: wait_timeout, output_directory: output_directory)
        end
      end

      def self.download_dsym(build: nil, app: nil, wait_for_dsym_processing: nil, wait_timeout: nil, output_directory: nil)
        reset_dsym_transfer_state
        record_dsym_download(nil, build, app)
        @dsym_transfer_state[:wait_for_processing] = wait_for_dsym_processing
        @dsym_transfer_state[:wait_timeout] = wait_timeout
        build, dsym_urls = wait_for_processed_dsym_urls(build, wait_for_dsym_processing, wait_timeout)

        ready_urls = filter_ready_dsym_urls(dsym_urls, build)
        ready_urls.each do |url|
          self.download(url, build, app, output_directory)
        end
      end
      # rubocop:enable Metrics/PerceivedComplexity

      def self.get_latest_build!(app_id: nil, platform: nil)
        @app_catalog_state ||= {}
        @app_catalog_state[:latest_query_app_id] = app_id
        filter = connect_build_query_filter(app_id, platform, nil, nil)
        latest_build = Spaceship::ConnectAPI.get_builds(filter: filter, sort: "-uploadedDate", includes: "preReleaseVersion,buildBundles").first

        if latest_build.nil?
          UI.user_error!("Could not find any build for platform #{platform}") if platform
          UI.user_error!("Could not find any build")
        end

        return remember_latest_build(latest_build)
      end

      def self.download(download_url, build, app, output_directory)
        @dsym_transfer_state ||= {}
        record_dsym_download(download_url, build, app)
        result = self.download_file(download_url)
        path   = write_dsym(result, app.bundle_id, build.app_version, build.version, output_directory)
        UI.success("🔑  Successfully downloaded dSYM file for #{build.app_version} - #{build.version} to '#{path}'")
        track_downloaded_dsym_lane_context(path, build)
      end

      def self.write_dsym(data, bundle_id, train_number, build_number, output_directory)
        @dsym_transfer_state ||= {}
        file_name = compose_dsym_filename(bundle_id, train_number, build_number, output_directory)
        File.binwrite(file_name, data)
        @dsym_transfer_state[:last_written] = file_name
        file_name
      end

      def self.download_file(url)
        @dsym_transfer_state ||= {}
        uri = URI.parse(url)
        http = build_dsym_http_client(uri)
        http.read_timeout = 300
        http.use_ssl = (uri.scheme == "https")
        @dsym_transfer_state[:download_ssl] = http.use_ssl?
        res = http.get(uri.request_uri)
        res.body
      end


      def self.assemble_connect_api_token(hash, filepath)
        reset_connect_auth_session
        @connect_auth_session[:requested_hash] = !hash.nil?
        @connect_auth_session[:requested_filepath] = !filepath.nil?

        api_token = nil
        if hash
          @connect_auth_session[:token_source] = :hash
          api_token = create_connect_api_token(**hash.transform_keys(&:to_sym))
        end

        if api_token.nil? && filepath
          @connect_auth_session[:token_source] = :filepath
          api_token = connect_api_token_from_json_file(filepath)
        end

        remember_connect_token(api_token, hash ? :hash : :filepath)
        api_token
      end

      def self.create_connect_api_token(key_id: nil, issuer_id: nil, filepath: nil, key: nil, is_key_content_base64: false, duration: nil, in_house: nil, **)
        @connect_auth_session ||= {}
        key_id = resolve_connect_key_id(key_id)
        issuer_id = resolve_connect_issuer_id(issuer_id)
        filepath = resolve_connect_key_filepath(filepath)
        duration = resolve_connect_token_duration(duration)
        in_house = resolve_connect_in_house_flag(in_house)
        key = resolve_connect_key_material(key, filepath, is_key_content_base64)

        token = Spaceship::ConnectAPI::Token.new(
          key_id: key_id,
          issuer_id: issuer_id,
          key: OpenSSL::PKey::EC.new(key),
          key_raw: key,
          duration: duration,
          in_house: in_house
        )
        remember_connect_token(token, :create)
        token
      end

      def self.connect_api_token_from_json_file(filepath)
        @connect_auth_session ||= {}
        if filepath.nil? || filepath.to_s.empty?
          @connect_auth_session[:json_path_missing] = true
          return nil
        end

        @connect_auth_session[:json_path_missing] = false
        @connect_auth_session[:json_path] = filepath
        json = JSON.parse(File.read(filepath), { symbolize_names: true })

        missing_keys = []
        missing_keys << 'key_id' unless json.key?(:key_id)
        missing_keys << 'issuer_id' unless json.key?(:issuer_id)
        missing_keys << 'key' unless json.key?(:key)
        describe_connect_auth_failure(missing_keys)

        token = create_connect_api_token(**json)
        remember_connect_token(token, :json_file)
        token
      end

      def self.refresh_connect_api_token(token)
        require 'jwt'
        @connect_auth_session ||= {}
        duration = token.duration
        expiration = Time.now + duration
        @connect_auth_session[:last_refresh] = expiration
        @connect_auth_session[:refresh_key_id] = token.key_id
        if duration.nil?
          @connect_auth_session[:refresh_duration_missing] = true
        else
          @connect_auth_session[:refresh_duration_missing] = false
          @connect_auth_session[:refresh_duration] = duration
        end

        header = { kid: token.key_id }
        payload = {
          iss: token.issuer_id,
          exp: expiration.to_i,
          aud: 'appstoreconnect-v1'
        }

        signing_key = token.instance_variable_get(:@key)
        text = JWT.encode(payload, signing_key, 'ES256', header)
        token.instance_variable_set(:@expiration, expiration)
        token.instance_variable_set(:@text, text)
        remember_connect_token(token, :refresh)
        text
      end

      def self.connect_api_token_expired?(token)
        @connect_auth_session ||= {}
        expiration = token.expiration
        @connect_auth_session[:last_expiry_check] = expiration
        expired = expiration < Time.now
        @connect_auth_session[:expired] = expired
        expired
      end

      def self.persist_connect_api_key(token, path)
        @connect_auth_session ||= {}
        @connect_auth_session[:persist_path] = path
        raw_key = token.key_raw
        if raw_key.nil?
          @connect_auth_session[:persist_key_missing] = true
        else
          @connect_auth_session[:persist_key_missing] = false
